text:
incident-bot: 🔔 Canary alert: proxy-pool-eu-1 showing 20% 503s and connection errors over the last 5m. Canary traffic is ~3% of prod. auto-rollout status=degraded.
priya: acked, paging. I'm oncall.
priya: @carlos can you grab proxy logs and check if it's config drift or backend 502s?
carlos: looking now. initial grep shows `upstream reset` and `502 gateway` from service-auth.
alice: any customer-facing errors reported? marta-support?
marta-support: seeing a small uptick in support tickets referencing "uploads failing" but only a handful, no major outage.
platform-sre: tagging in — could be TLS config mismatch after last edge deploy. when did the proxy config change?
carlos: deploy-bot shows a config push at 1785548000 to proxy pool (edge-ssl-rotate).
priya: OK we need to decide quick: kill-switch the feature flag for canary traffic or revert the edge config. which is faster?
alice: kill-switch flag is fastest — flips in <30s via FF service. Revert needs rollback and warming.
priya: do it. alice, flip the canary flag to 0 and confirm traffic drops.
alice: flipping `canary_proxy_route` -> `off` now :eyes:
incident-bot: SYSTEM: Feature flag `canary_proxy_route` set to off by alice at 1785550120. Canary traffic should drain within ~60s.
carlos: logs show 503s dropping after flag flip. still seeing TLS handshake errors from a subset of proxies though.
priya: good. keep monitoring. Carlos, can you run a quick smoke against auth and upload flows?
carlos: running smoke: `/scripts/smoke.sh --flow upload --target canary`
```
# smoke output
upload: ok
auth: ok
profile fetch: ok
```
carlos: smoke looks clean on canary after drain.
marta-support: I'll message affected customers we saw and say we mitigated and are monitoring.
priya: we should still roll back the config push to be safe. schedule manual rollback for the config push and coordinate with platform-sre.
platform-sre: prepared rollback play: `redwoodctl config revert --service proxy-pool-eu-1 --at 1785547999` — target window now. need approval to execute.
alice: approved. execute when ready.
platform-sre: executing rollback now.
platform-sre: rollback applied. verifying health.
priya: verify canary and prod metrics over next 10m. check error rates and latency.
carlos: 5m post-rollback: 503s back to baseline (<0.1%), latency normalized. no new errors in auth.
priya: great. marta-support, follow up with customers that we're fully recovered and we performed a config rollback.
marta-support: will do.
priya: creating incident record and assigning postmortem owner. action items: (1) reproduce config rotation in staging, (2) add automated smoke after edge-ssl rotates, (3) tighten rollback runbook timing.
alice: noted. I'll add the FF quick-drain play to the rollback runbook. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: canary-proxy-tls-drift - mitigated, severity=P2, pages=1, oncall=priya, incident_id=INC-2026-1785559999.
priya: thanks team. closing thread after postmortem triage.
__notes: Generated Slack incident thread about a canary proxy config problem, kill-switch feature flag flip, manual rollback and verification. All fields are flat strings or arrays of strings as required.
